concepts.name: ESM Polling
concepts.text: Lambda polls shards and invokes functions synchronously in order; producers never call Lambda.

concepts.name: Error Handling
concepts.text: Errors retry until expiry and block shards; use bisect, max retries/age, OnFailure dest and partial batch.

concepts.name: Fan-out & Filter
concepts.tag: Amazon Kinesis Data Streams + AWS Lambda
concepts.text: Use enhanced fan-out for dedicated 2 MB/s per shard per consumer, or filter criteria to skip unmatched events.

concepts.name: DynamoDB Streams
concepts.text: Captures item changes for 24 h (KEYS_ONLY, NEW/OLD images); retries are at-least-once, so write idempotently.

Bisect + max retries + on-failure dest + partial batch
isolates and skips poison pills without blocking
consumer can't keep up, shards are fine

items.label: Isolate (Bisect)
items.text: Enable BisectBatchOnFunctionError and ReportBatchItemFailures to split bad batches and skip good records.

items.label: Cap Retries / Age
items.text: Set MaximumRetryAttempts or MaximumRecordAgeInSeconds so bad records stop blocking shards and IteratorAge.

items.label: Route Failures
items.text: Send failed batch metadata to an ESM OnFailure destination (SQS, SNS, S3 or Kafka) for later inspection.

Cut invocation cost; avoid reprocessing good items

tips: Producers never invoke Lambda for Kinesis—Lambda polls via the ESM. 'Call Lambda from producer' is a distractor.
Function-level SQS DLQs apply only to async invocations; for stream ESMs, configure the ESM OnFailure destination.
Kinesis ESM concurrency = shards × ParallelizationFactor; setting reserved concurrency too low causes throttling.
Ordering holds per shard (per partition key if ParallelizationFactor > 1); raising timeout won't fix a poison pill.
